 A Guide to Thanksgiving Travel at PHX
 Reserve parking and a spot at the security checkpoint 
 PHOENIX – Historically, Thanksgiving is one of the busiest travel periods of the year at America’s Friendliest Airport ® . To help make your holiday travel go as smoothly as possible, Phoenix Sky Harbor has prepared a step-by-step guide to navigate a busy travel weekend.
 Step One – Reserve Parking 
 Parking fills up quickly, and one way to ensure availability is by reserving a spot in advance. You can reserve a parking space in the economy parking facilities and terminal garages.
 To reserve a spot, view parking rates, and find availability, visit skyharbor.com/parking. 
 Step Two – Avoid Terminal Curb Congestion 
 Steer clear of terminal traffic by dropping off and picking up at the 24th or 44th Street PHX Sky Train® stations. The PHX Sky Train® operates 24 hours a day and is free to the public. It connects travelers to Valley Metro Rail at 44th and Washington streets, the East Economy Parking area, the airport terminals, 24th Street Economy Parking area and the Rental Car Center. The roadways are especially busy around the Thanksgiving holiday. Using the 24th Street or 44th Street PHX Sky Train ® Stations for pickup and drop-off helps save time and avoid traffic.
 Step Three – Use PHX RESERVE 
 A parking space isn’t the only thing you can reserve in advance at Phoenix Sky Harbor. Travelers may reserve a time at the TSA Security Checkpoint screening area through PHX RESERVE, a free program available in both terminals. PHX RESERVE has expanded and is now available at all four checkpoints in Terminal 4. Reservations can be scheduled anytime between one hour and six days before your scheduled flight time.
 Reserve a time at skyharbor.com/phxreserve 
 Step Four – Plan ahead 
 Other tips on being ready to travel:
 Be REAL ID ready or have an acceptable form of ID.
 Check out TSA’s “ What Can I Bring Page? ” for guidance on packing uncommon items.
 Plan to arrive at least two hours before the scheduled flight departure for domestic flights and three hours for international travel.
 Step Five – Check before leaving 
 Before heading out the door, check these things twice:
 Check the flight status with your airline.
 Check the TSA wait times at com 
 Check for any roadway restrictions on our website .
 Step Six – At PHX 
 Keep these tips in mind as you make your way to the airport:
 Use Early Bag Check , available at the East Economy Lot and the Rental Car Center.
 Take a look at our tips for traveling with kids .
 Picking someone up? Wait at one of our three Cell Phone Waiting Lots instead of circling the terminals.
 Lastly, once at the airport, feel free to ask our friendly Navigators a question or take some time to check out our Phoenix Airport Museum .
 For more travel tips, check out skyharbor.com/flying-from-phx/travel-tips .

 Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport, America’s Friendliest Airport ® , has an annual economic impact of more than $44 billion. On an average day, approximately 1,300 aircraft and more than 140,000 passengers arrive at and depart from Phoenix Sky Harbor. PHX is funded with airport revenue. No tax dollars are used to support the airport.
